data.description:
## Context / Problem
A plan edited mid-review completes all remaining passes and then fails to sign (generation re-check, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/generation.py:143-168) — every call after the edit is pure waste, and checkpoints are keyed by material fingerprint (sizing.py:454-459) so no completed chunk survives the edit. The sign-time equality was deliberately narrowed to own material + pinned deps, excluding tracker HEAD and the relation snapshot (commit 7c3c08df8, bug d70a: store-wide equality aborted signing on unrelated writes) — the cancel predicate must respect the same scoping or it reintroduces d70a as false cancels.

## Approach
(1) Add generation.own_material_changed(ticket_id, initial_generation, repo_root): compares ONLY own_material via attest.current_material_fingerprint (attest.py:755 — a single-ticket read), wrapped in ticket_reads.local_read_context() so the probe never triggers fetch/reconverge. (2) Thread a threading.Event cancel token through produce_plan_review_verdict into the workflow: probed at exactly two seams — after the finders step and after decide (before coach); when set, pass1._chunk (pass1.py:419) returns [] immediately for any not-yet-started chunk and remaining passes are skipped. (3) The cancelled run returns claimability.indeterminate_verdict (claimability.py:123-167) with finding id plan-review-cancelled-stale, no signature, no sidecar (sidecar writes advance the store revision, __init__.py:750-755), exit 2. No cancellation on related_material drift — that discards reusable checkpoints and the sign-time check already handles it. Alternative rejected: per-chunk probing with generation.collect() — a whole-store reduction that can take the sync lock, hostile from 6 pool threads.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/generation.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py, src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py, tests/llm/test_mid_review_cancel.py.

## Testing
Unit with FakeRunner: an own-material fingerprint change detected at the post-finders probe skips verify/coach, returns INDETERMINATE exit 2 with no signature and no sidecar; an unrelated store write (different ticket) does not cancel; no probe firing leaves behavior byte-identical to today; a cancelled run followed by re-review runs clean.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] An own-material change between passes cancels the review: INDETERMINATE, exit 2, zero signature, zero sidecar, verify/coach never invoked (checked: unit test with FakeRunner call recording).
- [ ] A write to a different ticket mid-run does NOT cancel (checked: unit test — guards against reintroducing bug d70a).
- [ ] The probe performs no fetch/reconverge (checked: unit test asserting ensure_fresh is not called from the probe path).
- [ ] With no mid-run change, review behavior and outputs are unchanged (checked: existing plan-review tests pass).
data.title: Cancel a plan review mid-run when the ticket's own material changes
